info.title: HippoBridge FHIR API
info.description: FHIR-compatible API for accessing patient data from the Hipocrate medical system

get.description: Returns the web interface for patient analysis with CNP input form

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Patient ID, 13-digit CNP, or partial CNP with asterisk (*)

get.description: Retrieve all service requests for a patient as FHIR ServiceRequest resources with optional filtering by type, region and datetime

parameters.name: patient
parameters.description: Patient ID, 13-digit CNP, or partial CNP with asterisk (*)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Analysis type to filter by (e.g., radio, ct, irm, eco, lab, lac, lii, rads, apa)

parameters.name: dt
parameters.description: Target date/time in ISO format. Filters requests to those closest to this timestamp using a binary-narrowing window (starts at ±24 h, halves on each ambiguous attempt until a single match is found).

200.description: Patient service requests as FHIR Bundle of ServiceRequest resources

get.description: Retrieve a single service request by ID. Without ?type, scrapes buletinRecoltari.asp (collection sheet: patient demographics, ordered procedures, physician, section). With ?type=cerere, scrapes cerere.asp (full request edit form: adds priority, clinical indication, justification, diagnosis, payment type, and numeric patient ID — returns 403 if the authenticated user lacks access to the lab).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Source hint: omit for buletinRecoltari (default), or pass 'cerere' for the full request edit form

get.description: Returns a searchset Bundle of ServiceRequest resources from the Hipocrate schedule page. Lab and patient filters are passed as native Hipocrate URL params; section is filtered server-side by name.

parameters.name: refresh

get.description: Same as /fhir/Schedule but returns raw HippoData JSON. Accepts the same query parameters.

Scrapes cerere.asp (request edit form) and returns patient name, CNP, demographics, numeric patient ID, request date/time, priority, payment type, physician, section, diagnosis, clinical indication, justification, request code, laboratory name, and exam list. Returns an access-denied error for labs the authenticated user cannot view; use /api/request/{id} (buletinRecoltari) as fallback for patient demographics in that case. Supports ?debug=page.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Pass 'page' to get raw Hipocrate HTML

200.description: Full request and patient details as HippoData JSON

get.description: Returns entry count, total size, age range, and a by_table breakdown (entries per endpoint kind, e.g. cache_patient/cache_checkout/...) of the on-disk SQLite HTTP cache. {"enabled": false} when no cache.dir is configured.

post.description: Deletes expired/oversized entries from the on-disk SQLite HTTP cache and returns counts. No-op ({"enabled": false}) when no cache.dir is configured.

Generate a free-text AI summary for one item, in-process against the configured LLM provider (llm.cfg). Results are cached (in-memory + disk) keyed by (kind, sha256(text)). These are deliberately weak-guarantee aids: no schema, no validation.

check_only.description: Skip generation, just report whether a cached summary exists

400.description: Invalid JSON, unknown kind, empty text, or not enough clinical content to summarize

503.description: AI summaries not configured, or the AI service is unreachable

post.description: Streaming counterpart to /api/ai/summarize, for kind in {report, epicrisis, pre_exam, lab}. On a cache hit the full cached text is written as a single chunk. Mid-stream failures can't change the HTTP status (client already committed to 200) — signalled instead with a sentinel: ASCII Unit Separator + "ERROR" + Unit Separator + message.

200.description: text/plain streamed summary chunks (or a mid-stream error sentinel)

400.description: Invalid JSON, unsupported kind, empty text, or not enough clinical content to summarize
